name: WorkspaceSplit
purpose: Master–detail (optional tools) workspace that morphs single-column ↔ split via container queries.
scenarios: Queue + editor workspace that stacks on phone and splits from tablet
Queue + canvas + tools three-pane desktop layout without freezing CSS Grid

tools.description: Optional tools / inspector pane. Stacks on compact; under detail on tablet; third column at desktop.

masterWidth.description: Preferred master column width from tablet up.

toolsWidth.description: Preferred tools column width at desktop.

collapseBelow.description: Documented threshold. Morph uses token breakpoints 48rem/80rem; custom lengths are not applied.

scrollMode.description: Unique scroll owner. shell (default): AppShell __main scrolls, panes do not. panes: fill host and pane overflow:auto. none: no default pane scroll.

masterScroll.description: Per-pane override. null/omitted follows scrollMode (true only for panes). Explicit true/false wins.

detailScroll.description: Per-pane override. null/omitted follows scrollMode (true only for panes). Explicit true/false wins.

toolsScroll.description: Per-pane override. null/omitted follows scrollMode (true only for panes). Explicit true/false wins.

antiPatterns: Do not freeze a desktop CSS Grid or Stack direction=row for the same master/detail job — that fights Navigation morph and squeezes columns on compact.
Do not nest a second AppShell Navigation inside a pane.
Do not enable pane *Scroll (or scrollMode=panes) and also fight AppShell __main with a second overflow:auto — one scroll owner only.
Do not nest a second WorkspaceSplit inside detail — nested splits always stack; use the outer tools slot.

responsive.strategy: Named container workspace-split restyles the inner frame. Compact is one column; 48rem opens master|detail; 80rem opens tools as a third column when present.

breakpoints.compact: Single column: master, then detail, then tools.
breakpoints.medium: Master | detail; tools stacks under detail when present.
breakpoints.large: Master | detail | tools when tools is present; otherwise master | detail.
